About LSM Studio LSM Studio is a boutique firm with offices in Washington, DC and New York. For over 34 years, our studio has been a leader in workplace design and offers a full spectrum of architectural and creative services to a global client base.
Job Description
We are looking for a thoughtful and motivated architectural design professional to work in-person in our Washington, DC studio.
Candidates for this position will be required to coordinate with firm leaders to produce drawings, graphics, and presentations for the LSM team and our clients; collaborate with consultants; interface with clients; and administer construction documents in the office and on site. Registration is preferred but not required.
Qualifications
Candidates should have:
An accredited Graduate Degree in Architecture
2-3 years of well-rounded experience.
Experience creating and administering construction documents.
The ability to track multiple projects and agility to work with multiple project teams.
Professional communication skills and ability to interface with clients and studio leadership comfortably and confidently.
Advanced aptitude in industry standard software and creative software, including but not limited to:
BIM: Revit
2-D CAD Software
3-D Modeling and Rendering: Rhino, V-Ray, Enscape
Adobe Creative Suite
Microsoft Office Suite
Strong written and graphic communication skills.
The willingness and ability to travel to facilitate projects.
